description: Letter from Shelomo Cesana & Company to Karo y Frances & Company, in Fustat/Cairo. In Judaeo-Arabic. Dated: 4 Tishrei 5569 AM, which is 25 September 1808 CE. There is also a postscript in Ladino signed by Avram al-[...], clearly relating to the main content because Karo y Frances are mentioned in this part as well. Needs examination for content.
description_he: מכתב משלמה צ'זאנה ושות' לחברת קארו אי פרנסס, פסטאט/קהיר. ביהודית-ערבית. תאריך: ד' תשרי ה'תקס"ט = 25 בספטמבר 1808. עם פוסקריפטום בלאדינו.
